notes:
- Fixed: avatars/outfits that name leg bones with side prefixes (e.g. LeftUpperLeg) used to silently lose all leg weights and the worn legs would not follow; they now convert correctly, and any bone that still cannot be matched is listed in a console warning
- Fixed: panties with small detached decorations (metal rings, studs, buttons, ribbons, layered panels) no longer get crushed or torn in pull states - each piece now rides the fabric beneath it
- Improved: low-poly panties get smoother pull shapes
- New: in keep mode the pull is now band-led - the waistband slides down first while the panty keeps its worn shape
- Note: re-run Bake on converted panties after updating to apply the fixes
